title: Skyboy plugin manifest
description: Machine-readable manifest for one plugin under plugins/<plugin-name>/. The file must be named plugin.json and live in that folder. Plugins are indexed and linked, never vendored: source_url points at the upstream repo as the source of truth.

name.description: The plugin's slug. Must equal the folder name under plugins/.

description.description: What the plugin bundles and who it is for.

source_url.description: The upstream repo. Skyboy indexes and links; it never vendors the content. `skyboy update` re-fetches from here.

skills.description: Skill names the plugin bundles upstream. Plugins are indexed and linked, never vendored: these names resolve against the plugin's source_url repo, not the skills/ tree.

hooks.description: Hook scripts the plugin ships (e.g. auto-format-on-save).

agents.description: Agent definitions the plugin ships (e.g. code-reviewer-agent).

contents.description: What the plugin contains. At least one skill.

vendor.description: Display name of the publishing vendor, when the plugin is vendor-published.

license.description: SPDX identifier for the plugin's own manifest. Bundled content licenses are verified per file upstream.

category.description: Optional display category. Plugin skill categories also feed the dynamic category list.

install.description: One-line install command shown on the plugin page.

mcp.description: MCP endpoint the plugin publishes, if any.

path_prefix.description: Upstream folder where the bundled skills live (e.g. 'skills' or 'plugins'). Defaults to 'skills'.
